# SpikingTrafficSignRecognition

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A specialized application of spiking neural networks for real-time traffic sign classification, encoding visual inputs into spike trains and processing them through temporal dynamics. Demonstrates the practical viability of SNNs in safety-critical, low-power automotive scenarios, a key target for in-network neuromorphic deployment.
